Index.meta_title: ExpenseHub - Multi-tenant expense tracking for growing organizations.
Index.meta_description: Track, categorize, and report on organizational spend with complete data isolation between teams. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Clerk.

Hero.title: Expense tracking your <important>whole organization</important> can trust.
Hero.description: ExpenseHub gives every organization its own isolated workspace for tracking spend — team members log expenses, admins see the full picture, and no organization ever sees another's data.

Features.section_title: Built for organizations, not just individuals
Features.section_description: Every feature is designed around one principle: your organization's financial data stays yours, and only yours.
Features.feature1_description: Every expense is scoped to an organization at the database level, so one team can never see another's spending.
Features.feature2_description: Expenses are logged against your organization, not a single user, so the full team stays in sync automatically.
Features.feature3_description: Clerk-powered roles decide who can add expenses and who manages the organization, right out of the box.
Features.feature4_description: See this month's total, expense count, and category breakdown the moment you open your dashboard.
Features.feature5_description: Group spend by category to spot trends before they become a problem.
Features.feature6_description: Authentication and organization membership are handled by Clerk, so access control is never an afterthought.

FAQ.question_1: How does ExpenseHub keep my organization's data separate from others?
FAQ.answer_1: Every expense record is tagged with an organization ID that comes from your authenticated session, never from user input, and every database query is filtered by it. Organizations can never read or write each other's data.
FAQ.question_2: Can more than one person in my organization track expenses?
FAQ.answer_2: Yes. Any member of your organization can add expenses, and everyone sees the same shared, up-to-date list scoped to that organization.
FAQ.question_3: Do I need a credit card to try ExpenseHub?
FAQ.answer_3: No. You can create an organization and start tracking expenses right away.
FAQ.question_4: What information do I need to log an expense?
FAQ.answer_4: Just an amount, a category, and a date. A description is optional.
FAQ.question_5: Can I see spending broken down by category?
FAQ.answer_5: Yes. Your dashboard shows a monthly total, expense count, and a breakdown by category as soon as you sign in.
FAQ.answer_6: ExpenseHub uses Clerk for authentication and organization management, so sign-in, invitations, and roles are handled securely out of the box.
